## opencode-auth-load-balancer@0.9.1 → 0.10.0 - package.json
### Minor
- Codex accounts whose plan usage is exhausted keep serving on their ChatGPT credits, as the Codex CLI and desktop app do. Plan quota on any account is still spent first, a session on credits moves back as soon as plan headroom returns, and credits stopped by their spending cap are not used. The dashboards and TUI show the remaining balance beside the exhausted state (`full · credits 42.5`). Credits are stored where earlier plugin versions running at the same time cannot erase them, and turns waiting for quota recheck at least every five minutes.

## opencode-auth-load-balancer@0.9.0 → 0.9.1 - package.json
### Patch
- Recover stale quota cooldowns after a measured quota reset or re-login, and keep idle accounts refreshed with a shared five-minute polling schedule. Retry usage HTTP 401 once through the existing OAuth refresh lock for Claude, Codex and Kimi, without retrying 403/429 or refreshing static API keys. Missing user:profile permission still requires a fresh OAuth login.

## opencode-auth-load-balancer@0.8.1 → 0.9.0 - package.json
### Minor
- Share OAuth logins (Claude, Codex, Kimi sign-in) through the encrypted gist: the newest login wins, a refresh is published right after it commits and looked up before the next one, and pasting a link or logging in again uploads at once. The gist payload becomes version 3, so update every machine that follows the gist. Stop minting Claude inference tokens by default: Anthropic answers that grant with an 8-hour token and narrows the login to user:inference.

## opencode-auth-load-balancer@0.8.0 → 0.8.1 - package.json
### Patch
- Allow OpenCode 1 OpenTUI 0.5.10 hosts to install the default V1 plugin without npm peer dependency conflicts.

## opencode-auth-load-balancer@0.7.2 → 0.8.0 - package.json
### Minor
- Restore OpenCode 1 default server and TUI entries; recover unexpired OAuth access tokens rejected with HTTP 401 using a bounded, lock-safe refresh and account rotation.
